source_statement: The participating hospitals supplied U-TEG MA values and voltage recordings, together with the corresponding instrument-exported TEG readouts.
runtime_input: U-TEG inputs are indexed on a 900-point grid at one-second intervals (15 minutes). The 5- and 10-minute windows cover the first 300 and 600 grid points. Processing masks identify the points retained for fitting. The runner loads saved early fits and stored full-record coefficients; parameter preparation precedes model evaluation.
analysis_scope: The stored amplitudes exactly reproduce a construction using reference TEG MA. The saved early fits also reproduce a transformation using full-record amplitude information. We therefore interpret the results as analyses of these fixed inputs, without an independent demonstration of reference-free or strictly early-time prediction.
runtime_scope: The runtime flags describe loading saved features during evaluation. They do not establish reference or temporal independence of the stored inputs.
